requirements_summary: Objective: build a production RAG search over legacy media content. Index size target: 50M chunks (estimated 8-12TB of vectors). Primary retrieval must return high recall candidates within 100ms; full ranked reponse (top-K with reranker) target p95 < 800ms. Cost sensitivity: want <$0.10/query (all-in) at 50 QPS steady. Must support SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, and ability to pin model versions for audits.
tech_constraints: on-prem connector for air-gapped content ingestion
chunking_strategy_notes: Current thinking: dynamic chunking by semantic boundaries (scene/segment markers) + size cap. Experiment plan: 1) fixed 512-token chunks with 128 token overlap; 2) variable-sized chunks using topic-segmentation (avg 800 tokens) with no overlap; 3) hybrid: large chunks for metadata-heavy passages + small chunks for dense transcripts. Evaluate recall@100 and downstream reranker latency/cost. SE notes: overlap reduces missed context but increases index size ~30%.
perf_targets: Target queries: steady 50 QPS, peak bursts 200 QPS. Retrieval target: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms (dense vector lookup). End-to-end top-1 latency goal: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 800ms. Cost target: <$0.10/query (including retrieval + rerank + token gen). Storage budget: prefer DSS-style sharding to keep warm memory under 1.5TB per node.
poc_plan: Week 1: ingest 200k anonymized paragraphs (representative mix of transcripts + shot lists), validate chunking strategies
Week 2: baseline retrieval with Redwood hosted embeddings (const model) + Faiss, measure recall & latency
Week 3: run reranker variants (A/B) and measure precision lift vs cost; iterate on candidate size
Week 4: Dedicated node draft config (GPU sizing, shard counts), run 24-hour QPS soak test
Week 5-6: security validation (KMS proof-of-concept), finalize pricing and SOW for Dedicated commitment
